context: Dr. Saito briefs nurse Yumiko on an incoming emergency patient at the hospital.
purpose: Medical professionals coordinating under pressure with calm clarity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 緊急の患者さん、五分後に着きます。
lines.en: Emergency patient arriving in five minutes.
lines.style: measured doctor voice, calm urgency, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: composed nurse, professional alert, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 出血が多い。痛みも強いそうです。
lines.en: Heavy bleeding. Strong pain reported too.
lines.style: clinical male voice, careful informing, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 輸血の準備、進めておきます。
lines.en: I'll prepare for transfusion right away.
lines.style: efficient nurse, clipped and steady, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 助かります。血液型の確認も。
lines.en: That helps. Confirm blood type as well.
lines.style: grateful doctor voice, focused, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はい、家族にも連絡しましょうか?
lines.en: Yes — should I contact the family?
lines.style: thoughtful nurse, considerate prompt, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お願いします。落ち着いた口調で。
lines.style: experienced doctor, gentle reminder, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もちろんです。注意して伝えます。
lines.en: Of course. I'll be careful in how I tell them.
lines.style: compassionate nurse, measured promise, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: チーム全員、対応に集中してください。
lines.en: Whole team — focus on the response.
lines.style: leading physician, authority with care, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 了解しました。先生、頼みます。
lines.style: steady nurse, professional trust, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こちらこそ。一緒に乗り切りましょう。
lines.en: Likewise. Let's get through this together.
lines.style: warm doctor, quiet camaraderie, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: firm nurse, resolved softness, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery
